run_learner_loop: run the Atari RL learner loop with actors, inference, and training on GPU devices
compute_loss_vtrace: compute the combined policy gradient, baseline, and entropy loss using vtrace returns
create_rollouts_buffer: create a Rollouts buffer to collect and manage timestep data from multiple actors
checkpoint_save_load: save and load model, optimizer, and scheduler checkpoints to and from disk
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to start the learner with absl flags and logging
